title_ko: 👑 EMERGENCY: Penguin #213 is holding ALL THREE #1 spots hostage 🐧🏆
title_en: 👑 EMERGENCY: Penguin #213 is holding ALL THREE #1 spots hostage 🐧🏆
body_ko:
Look at this smug little menace.
Eyes closed. Chewing on a piece of straw. Balancing a golden goblet on his head for absolutely no reason.
Right now, Penguin #213 is sitting at #1 across ALL THREE arcade games at the exact same time:
✈️ Plane — #1 (Penguin #213)
🚢 Icebreaker — #1 (Still Penguin #213)
🏎️ Car — #1 (Yes, Penguin #213 again... bro needs to touch grass)
🎁 What do you get if you beat him?
▫️ Prize money: $0
▫️ Airdrop: 0 VERY
▫️ Utility: Absolutely nothing.
▫️ Actual reward: Wiping that annoying smile off #213’s face.
Are you really going to let a penguin with his eyes shut beat you in 3 different games?
Somebody please go dethrone this guy. 🕹️🔥
